data:
@Homotopy.{u_1, u_2,
    u_3} : {ι : Type u_3} →
  {V : Type u_2} →
    [inst : CategoryTheory.Category.{u_1, u_2} V] →
      [inst_1 : @CategoryTheory.Preadditive.{u_1, u_2} V inst] →
        {c : ComplexShape.{u_3} ι} →
          {C D :
              @HomologicalComplex.{u_1, u_2, u_3} ι V inst
                (@CategoryTheory.Preadditive.preadditiveHasZeroMorphisms.{u_1, u_2} V inst inst_1) c} →
            @Quiver.Hom.{max u_3 u_1, max (max u_2 u_3) u_1}
                (@HomologicalComplex.{u_1, u_2, u_3} ι V inst
                  (@CategoryTheory.Preadditive.preadditiveHasZeroMorphisms.{u_1, u_2} V inst inst_1) c)
                (@CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.toQuiver.{max u_3 u_1, max (max u_2 u_3) u_1}
                  (@HomologicalComplex.{u_1, u_2, u_3} ι V inst
                    (@CategoryTheory.Preadditive.preadditiveHasZeroMorphisms.{u_1, u_2} V inst inst_1) c)
                  (@CategoryTheory.Category.toCategoryStruct.{max u_3 u_1, max (max u_2 u_3) u_1}
                    (@HomologicalComplex.{u_1, u_2, u_3} ι V inst
                      (@CategoryTheory.Preadditive.preadditiveHasZeroMorphisms.{u_1, u_2} V inst inst_1) c)
                    (@HomologicalComplex.instCategory.{u_1, u_2, u_3} ι V inst
                      (@CategoryTheory.Preadditive.preadditiveHasZeroMorphisms.{u_1, u_2} V inst inst_1) c)))
                C D →
              @Quiver.Hom.{max u_3 u_1, max (max u_2 u_3) u_1}
                  (@HomologicalComplex.{u_1, u_2, u_3} ι V inst
                    (@CategoryTheory.Preadditive.preadditiveHasZeroMorphisms.{u_1, u_2} V inst inst_1) c)
                  (@CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.toQuiver.{max u_3 u_1, max (max u_2 u_3) u_1}
                    (@HomologicalComplex.{u_1, u_2, u_3} ι V inst
                      (@CategoryTheory.Preadditive.preadditiveHasZeroMorphisms.{u_1, u_2} V inst inst_1) c)
                    (@CategoryTheory.Category.toCategoryStruct.{max u_3 u_1, max (max u_2 u_3) u_1}
                      (@HomologicalComplex.{u_1, u_2, u_3} ι V inst
                        (@CategoryTheory.Preadditive.preadditiveHasZeroMorphisms.{u_1, u_2} V inst inst_1) c)
                      (@HomologicalComplex.instCategory.{u_1, u_2, u_3} ι V inst
                        (@CategoryTheory.Preadditive.preadditiveHasZeroMorphisms.{u_1, u_2} V inst inst_1) c)))
                  C D →
                Type (max u_3 u_1)

@HomotopyEquiv.{u_1, u_2,
    u_3} : {ι : Type u_3} →
  {V : Type u_2} →
    [inst : CategoryTheory.Category.{u_1, u_2} V] →
      [inst_1 : @CategoryTheory.Preadditive.{u_1, u_2} V inst] →
        {c : ComplexShape.{u_3} ι} →
          @HomologicalComplex.{u_1, u_2, u_3} ι V inst
              (@CategoryTheory.Preadditive.preadditiveHasZeroMorphisms.{u_1, u_2} V inst inst_1) c →
            @HomologicalComplex.{u_1, u_2, u_3} ι V inst
                (@CategoryTheory.Preadditive.preadditiveHasZeroMorphisms.{u_1, u_2} V inst inst_1) c →
              Type (max u_3 u_1)

@HomotopyEquiv.toHomologyIso.{u_1, u_2,
    u_3} : {C : Type u_2} →
  [inst : CategoryTheory.Category.{u_1, u_2} C] →
    [inst_1 : @CategoryTheory.Preadditive.{u_1, u_2} C inst] →
      {ι : Type u_3} →
        {c : ComplexShape.{u_3} ι} →
          {K L :
              @HomologicalComplex.{u_1, u_2, u_3} ι C inst
                (@CategoryTheory.Preadditive.preadditiveHasZeroMorphisms.{u_1, u_2} C inst inst_1) c} →
            @HomotopyEquiv.{u_1, u_2, u_3} ι C inst inst_1 c K L →
              (i : ι) →
                [inst_2 :
                    @HomologicalComplex.HasHomology.{u_1, u_2, u_3} C inst
                      (@CategoryTheory.Preadditive.preadditiveHasZeroMorphisms.{u_1, u_2} C inst inst_1) ι c K i] →
                  [inst_3 :
                      @HomologicalComplex.HasHomology.{u_1, u_2, u_3} C inst
                        (@CategoryTheory.Preadditive.preadditiveHasZeroMorphisms.{u_1, u_2} C inst inst_1) ι c L i] →
                    @CategoryTheory.Iso.{u_1, u_2} C inst
                      (@HomologicalComplex.homology.{u_1, u_2, u_3} C inst
                        (@CategoryTheory.Preadditive.preadditiveHasZeroMorphisms.{u_1, u_2} C inst inst_1) ι c K i
                        inst_2)
                      (@HomologicalComplex.homology.{u_1, u_2, u_3} C inst
                        (@CategoryTheory.Preadditive.preadditiveHasZeroMorphisms.{u_1, u_2} C inst inst_1) ι c L i
                        inst_3)
